section.title: Cool Down Activity
section.para: A ceramic sugar bowl weighs 340 grams when empty. It is then filled with sugar. One tablespoon of sugar weighs 12.5 grams.

list.item: Write an equation to represent the relationship between the total weight of the bowl in grams, \( W \), and the tablespoons of sugar, \( T \).

div.para:
32 tablespoons;
\(740=340+12.5T\)
\(400=12.5T\); Subtract 340 from both sides.
\(32=T\); Divide both sides by 12.5.

list.item: When the sugar bowl is full, it weighs 740 grams. How many tablespoons of sugar can the bowl hold? Be prepared to show your reasoning.

div.para: Point D, because its coordinates could be (32, 740).

problem.para: The graph represents the relationship between the number of tablespoons of sugar in the bowl and the total weight of the bowl.

image.alt: Graph of a line. Weight, grams. Sugar, tablespoons.

list.item: Which point on the graph could represent your answer to the previous question?

div.para: About 21 tablespoons. Looking at the graph, when the weight is 600, the line is about at 21.

list.item: About how many tablespoons of sugar are in the bowl when the total weight is 600 grams?
